title: The Heaven Demon Phoenix Bell
summary: Xiao Yan's Fire Lotus holds against Feng Qing Er's Wind Killing Finger, and he shows two Heavenly Flames. Feng Qing Er reveals that she belongs to the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe and uses the tribe's secret technique to rise to Three-Star Dou Zong. Xiao Yan answers with the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes and merges three Heavenly Flames into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. She traps him in the Holy Icon Demon Phoenix Bell, made by a Dou Sheng ancestor of her tribe, but he breaks out and defeats her. After her loss, she senses her tribe's Ancient Phoenix Essence Blood on Xiao Yan and accuses him of stealing it. Feng Zun Zhe and the Falling Star Pavilion refuse to let her search his storage ring, but Xiao Yan agrees to her tribe's art of search to settle it.
events: The Fire Lotus beats the Wind Killing Finger.
Feng Qing Er reveals her Heaven Demon Phoenix wings and uses Bloodline Devouring Soul.
Her secret technique lifts her to Three-Star Dou Zong; Xiao Yan uses the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes.
Feng Zun Zhe learns why Lei Zun Zhe hid her aura.
Xiao Yan merges three Heavenly Flames into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
He escapes the Holy Icon Demon Phoenix Bell and wins the duel.
Feng Qing Er accuses him of holding the Ancient Phoenix Essence Blood.
Xiao Yan agrees to let her use her tribe's art of search on him.
cultivation: Feng Qing Er rises to Three-Star Dou Zong for the fight with her tribe's secret technique.
